title: Repo must never claim a published version it does not match
description:
INVARIANT

  A crate version, once on crates.io, is immutable. So a crate in this
  repo must never carry a version number that is already published with
  different code. Change a published crate's manifest, sources or build
  script and the version moves in the same commit. Publishing the new
  version is a separate decision; the bump alone restores the invariant.

WHY

  pkix-dane 0.2.0 was published, then edited in place and republished
  under the same number, and had to be yanked. Nothing detected it. The
  failure mode is quiet: `cargo build` in the workspace resolves path
  dependencies and is always happy, so the divergence is invisible until
  a consumer hits it.

CURRENT VIOLATIONS (as swept 2026-11-25)

  pkix-truststore-system 0.1.0
      The published 0.1.0 is the 42-line namespace-reservation stub whose
      rustdoc says "Stub crate" and "Linux trust stores are deliberately
      out of scope". The repo has a 648-line implementation plus apple.rs
      and windows.rs, a different package description, a [features]
      table, a pkix-truststore dependency, and target-specific
      security-framework / schannel dependencies. Landed in 739cabb4.

  pkix-truststore-pkcs11 0.1.0
      Lint header only: published has
      `#![deny(rust_2018_idioms, unreachable_pub)] #![warn(missing_docs)]`,
      repo has `#![warn(missing_docs, rust_2018_idioms)]` — the
      workspace-wide harmonisation. Still a published version whose code
      the repo does not match.

NOT violations, though they diverge in files no dependent compiles:
pkix-dnssec-anchor, pkix-path-builder, pkix-truststore, pkix-profiles-cabf,
pkix-lint-cabf, pkix-zlint-bridge, pkix-policy-zlint — test files, READMEs,
and the CHANGELOG.md files older tarballs still carry since this workspace
dropped them.

CORRECTION

  An earlier pass claimed pkix-dane-resolver and pkix-mta-sts had
  unpublished src changes. They do not. That came from reading git log
  for commits touching src/ after the version was last set, and the
  `git log -S` pickaxe found the wrong commit. Both crates match their
  published tarballs exactly. Compare tarballs, not history.

FIX

  scripts/check-registry-divergence.sh downloads every published tarball
  whose version the repo still claims and compares it. Hard failure on
  Cargo.toml (against the verbatim Cargo.toml.orig), src/ and build.rs,
  because those are what a dependent compiles. Everything else is
  reported, not failed. Wired into quality-gates.
